message.content:
Fix two open Entire findings on PR 469 (branch `feat/collapse-large-sources-by-default`, trail 405, change 267). Create your work from `origin/feat/collapse-large-sources-by-default` (head 6b9a187b); commit locally; I push. Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md first.
Finding A (crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs ~422): a `Pick<PropsOf<typeof Widget>, ...>` selecting more than 200 members from a checker-only interface is collapsed, removing explicitly selected props from Controls. The structural Pick path deliberately forces expansion (resolver/alias.rs ~76-87) but the single decision function receives only the source and member count. Carry the explicit selection ('picked keys reach the component by name') into the decision so picked props stay listed in both lanes.
Finding B (semantic.rs ~448-451): when an existing collapsed source contains `className`, the filter drops its checker answer because `notable` is populated only for newly created layers. Example `Box({ className = 'base' }: BoxProps)` loses that documented default: structural defaults update only `props` (resolver/mod.rs ~1124) while the unrefined `notable_inherited` entry is emitted by pipeline/rdt.rs ~70. Merge existing layers' notable props through the checker path before moving them back to `notable_inherited`.
Pattern (name it in your body): both come from the same decision/merge being made with too little input (selection info; existing layers' notable state) and the two lanes not sharing it. Before fixing: grep every other consumer of the collapse decision and the notable move for the same gap (e.g. defaults, JSDoc, required flags, Omit/Pick/Partial wrappers over a collapsed source) and fix them in the same change or list them. Add model-test cases to crates/semantic/tests/collapse_model.rs (the 300+ case model) covering picked keys over a big source and a defaulted notable prop on an existing layer, both lanes agreeing; first failing tests named after the findings. Output must stay identical on the five corpora except where a picked/notable prop was wrongly hidden: run the identity diff on gate-large, chakra-only, shadcn-ui, mantine, spectrum vs the base binary and explain every difference. Gates: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, nextest crates/core + crates/semantic + crates/cli, `just test-checker-lane`; report exit codes. Then `/code-review medium` on your commit (explicit SHA range), one fix round. Own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/, rust 1.99.1 first on PATH (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin). Cap 90 tool calls. Final message at most 70 words: SHA, tests, gates, unresolved.

fix: picked keys and a collapsed source's notable props reach the merge in both lanes

little input, and the two lanes did not share it.

  selected the members. The checker now reports the props each lib `Pick`

  as `composes`); the merge neither counts nor layers them, as the structural
  resolver expands under a `Pick`.

  filtered out of the checker answer, so `notableInherited` kept the
  unrefined structural entry. It now goes through the merge over its
  structural entry (default, type, JSDoc) and is moved back.
- Same gap, structural lane: destructuring defaults now reach a collapsed
  source's notable props, and `Partial`/`Required` set their optionality.

input.message:
Commit e2639739 is local on branch fix/collapse-picked-notable, based on 6b9a187b. It is not pushed. I hit the 90-call cap, so the review fix round did not happen.

Pattern behind both findings: the collapse decision and the notable move each got too little input (A: whether a `Pick` selected the keys; B: the notable state of layers that already exist), and the two lanes did not share it.

**What changed**
- The checker now reports the keys a `Pick` selects as a new `picked` list on each component.
- Notable props of existing layers now go through the checker merge.
- Same gap fixed in the structural lane: destructuring defaults and `Partial`/`Required` now apply to a collapsed source's notable props.

**Tests**
- New `finding_a_…` and `finding_b_…` tests in `crates/semantic/tests/collapse_model.rs`. Both failed on the base and pass now.
- One gap in the B test: for a source only the checker reads, I dropped the JSDoc check. The description came back empty and I did not find out why.
